title: A One-Step Cascade Symmetric Model: Rank-$1$ Packets, Binary Shielding, and the Even Exact-Cardinality Profile
summary: We introduce a one-step cascade symmetric system whose local symmetry geometry is organized by finite $ρ$-closed windows and one-step stars rather than by rowwise-independent toggles. The resulting symmetric model isolates a new $ZF + DC + \neg \mathrm{BPI}$ geometry in which rank-$1$ hereditarily symmetric reals admit a packet normalization theorem over countable $ρ$-closed supports. The technical center of the paper is the finite star-span lemma and the associated rank-$1$ packet calculus.
